# Reference

Precise technical descriptions — exact signatures, parameters, return types, and field dictionaries. Use these when you need the details, not a tutorial.

> **Status:** Hub — quick-links to the reference pages.

## Python API

Split into focused modules under [Python API](python-api/database.qmd):

- [Database](python-api/database.qmd) — views, `.get`, `.lookup`, `.search_fuzzy`, `.to_frame` / `.to_dicts`, iteration, errors.
- [Records](python-api/records.qmd) — `EnrichedRecord` fields and hierarchy properties.
- [Search](python-api/search.qmd) — `search_fuzzy()`, `SearchResult`.
- [Validation](python-api/validation.qmd) — `validate()` / `validate_many()`, `ValidationResult`.
- [Versioning](python-api/versioning.qmd) — `use_version()`, `use_plugins()`, `Database`, `AdminLevel`, module-level attributes.
- [FuzzBase](python-api/fuzzbase.qmd) — `create_fuzz_base()`, `FuzzBase` (performance).
- [Utilities](python-api/utilities.qmd) — sanitization, date resolution, env config.
- [Data models](python-api/data-models.qmd) — pydantic `AdminDiv` family and `DataManager`.
- [Legacy](python-api/legacy.qmd) — deprecated `search()`, `BARANGAY` dicts, `BarangayModel`.
